title: Osprey Arts Centre

services.name: Venue Rentals
services.desc: Consider renting our space for your next private event. The Osprey might be just what you’re looking for! With a variety of seating options, professional lighting and sound system, projection equipment, plus tables, tablecloths, dishes and cutlery, a kitchen and a fully stocked bar, our space is perfect for just about anything you can imagine. While our theatre can accommodate up to 120 people, we also rent our foyer for up to 40. The Osprey Arts Centre is the performing arts hub of Shelburne County, Nova
